# ex: replacement in selector X position gets parenthesized
ex {
	var x int
	F(x) -> x + 1
}
-- x.go --
package p

type T int

func (T) M() {}
func F(x int) T { return T(x) }

func f() {
	F(1).M()
}
-- stderr --
